summary: Documentation only: ADR-0087 (proposed) for the Windows agent - children without SYSTEM rights first (separate low-privilege token per child), the agent's own privileged operations split into a helper later; with the measurement plan that must run on a node before any code. Risk register next action points to it. No code, configuration or workflow change.

findings.evidence: The Windows agent runs as LocalSystem (needed for the GPU guard's NVML power limit and GPU-Z, measured 2026-09-24) and starts Ollama, Strata and the STT service - the code that handles network input - with SYSTEM rights.
findings.resolution: Proposal only: options, recommended order and a measurement plan (CUDA, folder access, Strata runtime folder, per-process VRAM attribution, job objects; NVML/GPU-Z/process paths/user hives for the later split). Decision stays with the operator.

limitations: No measurement has run yet; the outline may change with its results.
